notes: Continuation of a typewritten contents list. The sheet has typed page number - 541 - and archive number 85 at bottom left, the latter recorded only as a comment. It contains 25 numbered contents entries: 3.8–3.10, 4.1–4.6, 5.1–5.5 and 6.1–6.11, and three section headings: Sous-schémas et morphismes d'immersion . Schémas réduits; Morphismes séparés . Critères valuatifs; Conditions de finitude relatives. There is no date, independent chapter title, author signature, or explicit authorial doubt/question mark. Five explicit C doubts remain unresolved. Six overtyped letter positions are retained as deletions immediately before their live replacement. Four small graphic loci are represented without an asserted textual meaning: the lower mark at the section 4 period, a faint vertical trace by the leaders, the detached pair above 6.3, and the low trace beneath the 6.10 correction. These marks are not assumed to be authored handwriting or punctuation; material/accidental interpretations remain available. H supplies description only, so h_reading is null and diff_h is false throughout. No mathematical proof or computation was attempted. One whole-image view was followed by one half-a and one half-b view. Half b starts at whole-image y=995; the halves overlap by 160 pixels. Seven retained crops were each actually viewed once in batches of three, three, and one; no delivery was truncated and no locus was recropped. Detailed processing and the actual view ledger are saved beside this report. C-context confirmed, unmarked overprints are reported in math_reading_decisions.
